usedFor: Easybroker holds property enquiries and MailerLite holds your mailing list, so “New Contact Request” can run “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Request” in Easybroker, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Each enquiry becomes a subscriber, so people who asked about a property land on your mailing list.

watchOut: “Contact Is Created Or Updated” is polling and also fires on edits, so the same contact can run twice.
